summary_1line: Vyasa reveals the Pandavas are incarnations of ancient Indras and Draupadi a destined celestial wife, while Krishna and Balarama incarnate from Narayana’s hairs.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa grants King Drupada celestial sight, revealing the Pandavas shining with crowns and radiant bodies like gods.
Narayana plucks a black and a white hair from his body, which descend into the wombs of Devaki and Rohini.
A young ascetic maiden performs severe penance before Shiva, who appears and grants her the destiny of five husbands.
